meta.notes: Rebuild of pilot video 05 from the 30 fps decode. Frame ranges, emotion timelines, captions, counters and camera phases are measured (analysis/videos/05_*); layer depths, screen placements and lenses are planning choices from system/CAMERA_LANGUAGE.md. Word timings inside 2-word caption cards are split evenly until a WhisperX pass replaces them. Captions follow the on-screen text ("move to"), not the SRT ("moved to").

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You just watched two jackpot symbols land.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And the third one stopped one click short.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So, you move to the machine next door and the exact same thing happens.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your buddy leans over and says, "Bro, it's just warming up."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So, you put in another hundred, but it's starting to feel like the machine is teasing you on purpose.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Inside is a list of every place that last reel can stop.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The jackpot is on that list once.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One click short is on there over and over.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So, every time you spin, the machine is way more likely to stop one click short than on the jackpot.

shots.description: Hook: ECU of spinning reels, reveal pull-back + crane up to Lenny on a barstool, then a tension push while reel 3 stops one click short.

render.notes: x4 pull-back: use a detail inset plate for the ECU start (CAMERA_LANGUAGE M3 resolution budget).

params.note: lands on "jackpot" (#36-50); exact frame not logged

shots.description: Jump-cut re-pose, then a follow move-through (pull-back + crane up + truck right) as Lenny walks to the next machine; slow push while reel 3 lands one click short again.

render.notes: Walk = walk_cup pose card on a path + 2-frame bob; route to I2V if it looks stiff.

shots.description: POV from inside the machine: blurred reels in the foreground, Bling leans in and talks (2-state lip flap), Lenny side-eyes him; Beanie walks behind.
High dutch insert: Lenny's hand feeds a $100 bill into the acceptor; move-through up to CREDITS counting 0->100.

params.note: blank before #404, holds 100 to the end
green slot glow intensifies as the bill enters

shots.description: Low dutch CU: Lenny glares at the reels; face flickers hope->distrust on "teasing"; reel 3 stops one click short a third time.

characters.rim_light: strong warm orange rim from the machine side

shots.description: Determined Lenny stands, yanks the machine front open on a hinge; camera dives through the opening into the glowing reels.

render.notes: Cabinet front = hinged plane (a_machine_door_open texture); interior = emissive orange card.

shots.description: Cutaway inside the cabinet: reel 3 strip unrolls into the par-sheet list; glint + x1 badge on the jackpot row; stamp marks every BLANK row while a tally counter runs x01->x14; strip curls into a prize wheel.

i2v_segments.prompt: the long printed paper strip whips upward and curls into a closed ring that becomes a prize wheel; camera pulls back slightly; same lighting, no new objects

render.notes: Strip unroll = shape-key/curve deform on a long plane; morph #769-774 via I2V or a 3-frame cross-dissolve fallback.

shots.notes: Phases 560-640 and 768-778: measured values are inflated by the unrolling strip / morph (camera.md *); params are visual estimates, tune by eye.

shots.description: Cross-fade to an X-ray view while pulling out of the cabinet; prize wheel and reels spin, wheel lands on ONE CLICK SHORT next to JACKPOT; pull-back to deadpan Lenny.

render.notes: Cabinet = box with Wireframe modifier + emission #3fd8e8 on the lower half; wheel = textured disc rotating on its axis.

keys.value: ONE CLICK SHORT under pointer, JACKPOT sliver just left

params.note: ticks every frame; cents read .16.43 at #914 and .18.13 at #928

shots.notes: Phase 800-886: zoom reliable (~7.7 %/s); dx/dy/roll are polluted by the spinning wheel, so params zero them.
